integrity: Analytical proof provided; companion standard-library Python program independently checks rational coefficient and selected numerical equilibria. Finite computations are supporting tests only. No independent review or validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Discrete time, exactly two identical patches, Beverton–Holt recruitment, decreasing logistic emigration and fixed survival. Nonlinear asymptotics at the critical equilibrium, global attraction, and the total number of remote equilibria are not determined. Literature priority remains subject to inaccessible full texts and independent review.
title: A sharp symmetry-breaking threshold and biomass deficit in two identical population patches
